scope: Locate public originals of the Chinese submissions used in the July 31, 2012 sacks Section 129 final memorandum. Search limited to public, unauthenticated sources and a bounded DS437 exhibit-index trail.

sources.title: Final Determinations: Section 129 Proceedings Pursuant to the WTO Appellate Body’s Findings in WTO DS 379 Regarding the Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Investigations of Laminated Woven Sacks from the People’s Republic of China
sources.capture_status: Previously acquired official memorandum; reread for this follow-up, not a new acquisition
sources.reading_scope: Existing full 46-page reading remains in DEV-DS01. Follow-up reread: printed/PDF pp. 1–15, 17, 25 and 41–46 in full; keyword inspection of other pages only. Physical and printed pagination coincide.
findings: Exact dates and cited original-page locators for Chinese land, public-body and double-remedy responses.
The public-body and double-remedy discussions combine comments across four investigations; land specificity is confined to sacks (p. 2).
Only this final memorandum’s barcode is printed. The underlying Chinese filing barcodes are not recovered.
limitations: Commerce’s characterization and quotations of Chinese submissions are not the originals.
The date February 21, 2012 is explicitly attached to the CWP response; parallel sacks passages are separately paginated without independently acquired cover sheets.
This follow-up does not recover the May 18, 2012 petrochemical calculation attachment or decompose the rate increase.

sources.title: ACCESS Handbook on Electronic Filing Procedures, March 2026
sources.reading_scope: Printed/PDF pp. 5 and 20–21 read in full; §5 on pp. 20–21 is decisive. Remainder not read.
findings: Public documents and public versions require an authorized E-Filer or Guest User login.
A person wishing solely to view or download public versions must register as a Guest User.
sources.limitations: Describes the access route; does not independently confirm the availability or public-release status of any particular 2011–2012 filing.

sources.title: How To Register for Modernized ACCESS Guest User Account for New Users
sources.reading_scope: Text of PDF pp. 1–5 read; remaining pp. 6–13 not read. Embedded interface screenshots not independently visually inspected.
sources.findings: Registration instructions require email verification and the user’s name.
sources.limitations: No registration, account creation, email verification or outreach was undertaken.

sources.title: United States—Countervailing Duty Measures on Certain Products from China: Recourse to Article 21.5 of the DSU by China (DS437), First Written Submission of the United States of America, February 6, 2017
sources.source_type: Official U.S. party submission in a different WTO dispute
sources.reading_scope: Complete exhibit index, printed pp. x–xix (PDF pp. 11–20), read. Printed pp. viii–ix also displayed/read. Argument body not read for this follow-up.
findings: USA-1 identifies the May 18, 2012 Commerce memorandum listing public-body source documents; USA-2–82 are laws, policies, scholarship, reporting and other source materials.
USA-118–120 and USA-122 identify Chinese ministry benchmark responses dated July 6, 2015 in DS437, not the sought DS379 responses.
sources.limitations: The exhibit index was acquired; separate exhibits were not. No target original Chinese 2011–2012 filing was obtained. Do not count this as a full substantive reading of the 123-page submission.

sources.title: United States—Countervailing Duty Measures on Certain Products from China: Recourse to Article 21.5 of the DSU by China (DS437), Second Written Submission of the United States of America, March 27, 2017
sources.source_type: Official U.S. party submission in a different WTO dispute
sources.reading_scope: Printed pp. vii and 1–2 (PDF pp. 8–10) read in full; browser find results also inspected for exhibit cross-references. Remaining argument not read.
findings: Printed p. 2 n. 5 cross-refers to USA-1 and USA-2–82 for the May 18, 2012 Commerce public-body source materials.
Its own exhibit table adds USA-127 and USA-128, neither an original target Chinese filing.
sources.limitations: This is a bounded exhibit-trail check, not a full reading or a finding on DS437 compliance. No separate exhibit file acquired.
